draft.proposed_message:
Hi Amir,

Thank you for getting back to us, and don't worry — I'm very happy to help you get your identity verification sorted.

I've tried to locate your order on our system this morning using the email address you've written in from, but I'm afraid I haven't been able to match it to a record yet, so I don't want to guess and send you down the wrong path. So that I can pull up the right file and get this moving straight away, could you kindly reply with:

1. The company name (or proposed company name) on the order;
2. Your order number, if you have it to hand; and
3. The full name of the officer who needs to verify.

As soon as I have that, I'll check your record personally and ask our Compliance Team to send (or re-send) your Credas verification invitation.

In the meantime, here's how the verification works, so you know exactly what to expect:

1. You'll receive an email invitation from Credas containing a verification code.
2. Download the Credas app on your smartphone, enter the code and follow the on-screen prompts.
3. Please don't skip any question during registration — including your date of birth and address, as missed fields are the most common cause of a failed check.
4. If the Credas email hasn't arrived within 30 minutes, please have a quick look in your Spam or Junk folder, and let me know if it still isn't there.

What you'll need ready:

- One photo ID: a passport, photocard driving licence or national identity card. It must be a clear, readable, colour copy showing an issue date, and must not expire within the next 45 days.
- One proof of address dated within the last 3 months, personally addressed to you, showing your full home residential address, in English or accompanied by an official sworn translation. Please note that driving licences, tenancy agreements and residence certificates aren't accepted as proof of address.

If your verification is for the Companies House identity check where we issue the Personal Verification Code (PVC) as your authorised agent, only one biometric document can be used — a biometric or NFC-enabled passport (any country), a UK, Channel Islands, Isle of Man or EU photocard driving licence, or an EU/EEA identity card — with NFC switched on so the Credas app can read the chip. A passport generally gives the highest success rate, so I'd recommend that if you have one.

One last thing that really does matter: please reply to this email once you've finished the upload. Our system doesn't notify us automatically, and your confirmation is what allows me to push everything forward for you.

I'm a little conscious that anything waiting on this verification stays on hold until it's completed, and I'd hate for that to hold your company up unnecessarily — so do send those details over whenever you can and I'll take care of the rest.

Kind regards,
Rona

draft.proposed_message:
Hi Mahsin Zeeshan Ali,

Thank you for getting in touch, and thank you for renewing your Registered Office Address and Director's Service Address in London.

To answer your question first: yes, the Confirmation Statement is what used to be called the annual return. Companies House replaced the old annual return with the Confirmation Statement (form CS01), and it is a mandatory filing that every UK limited company must submit at least once a year, even if nothing has changed and even if the company is dormant or not trading.

Its purpose is simply to confirm that the information Companies House holds about your company is accurate and up to date, including:

1. Registered office address
2. Directors and company secretary (if applicable)
3. People with Significant Control (PSCs)
4. Shareholders and share capital
5. SIC code (business activity)

It is a separate filing from your annual accounts, which report what the company earned over its financial year, and separate again from Corporation Tax, which HMRC bills based on those earnings.

If you would like us to take care of the filing for you, our fee is £90 + VAT, and that includes ACSP identity verification support at no extra charge. If you hold our Premium 12 Month Company Filing Service, the filing is discounted to £50 + VAT instead — I will confirm which applies to you as soon as I can see your record.

So that I can check everything properly for you, could you please confirm:

1. Your company name and company number
2. The order number for the Registered Office and Director's Service Address payment you have made, so I can match it to your account

I would also like to make sure I am replying to the right person on the account, so if this email address is not the primary email registered with us, please send your confirmation from that address and I will pick it straight up.

One thing I did want to flag gently, simply because I would not want you to be caught out: the email you replied to was a renewal notice, and if any of the address services have lapsed while our address is still showing at Companies House, that can be treated as unauthorised use of our address and can put the company at risk. As soon as I have your company details I will check exactly what is active, what is due and on what date, and confirm everything to you.

One last point worth knowing ahead of the filing: since 18 November 2025 a Confirmation Statement is rejected if any director's Companies House personal code is missing, and anyone listed as a PSC has a separate duty to verify their own identity, even if they are also a director. The personal code is generated through GOV.UK One Login when the individual completes their own verification, so it is not something we can email out. I will guide you through it step by step when we get to that stage.

Please send those details over and I will come straight back to you.

Kind regards,
Rona

Once the company is incorporated I will send you the Wise instructions and referral details.
